import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = (int) 1e9;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] grid = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] target = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] distFromStart = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] distToTarget = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] id = new int[15][15];
    static int tot = 0;
    static int source, sink;

    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, flow;
        Edge(int to, int capacity) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new List[3005];

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        adj[u].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(v, cap));
        adj[v].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(u, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfsDist(int[][] startDist, int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 15; j++) {
                startDist[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        if (sx >= 0 && sx < n && sy >= 0 && sy < n && grid[sx][sy] != '#') {
            startDist[sx][sy] = 0;
            q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n &&
                    grid[nx][ny] >= '0' && grid[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                    startDist[nx][ny] > startDist[x][y] + 1) {
                    startDist[nx][ny] = startDist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static boolean[] levelGraph = new boolean[3005];
    static int[] ptr = new int[3005];

    static boolean bfsLevel() {
        Arrays.fill(levelGraph, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(source);
        levelGraph[source] = true;
        ptr[source] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                if (!levelGraph[e.to] && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                    levelGraph[e.to] = true;
                    ptr[e.to] = 0;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return levelGraph[sink];
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (; ptr[u] < adj[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
            int idx = adj[u].get(ptr[u]);
            Edge e = edges.get(idx);
            if (levelGraph[e.to] && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                int pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    edges.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfsLevel()) {
            int pushed;
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while ((pushed = dfs(source, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            grid[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            target[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }

        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    grid[i][j] = '0';
                }
                id[i][j] = ++tot;
            }
        }

        bfsDist(distFromStart, sx, sy);

        source = 2 * tot + 1;
        sink = source + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < 3005; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (grid[i][j] >= '1' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(source, id[i][j], grid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (target[i][j] >= '1' && target[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(id[i][j] + tot, sink, target[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (grid[i][j] >= '1' && grid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
                    int[][] dist = new int[15][15];
                    for (int x = 0; x < 15; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < 15; y++) {
                            dist[x][y] = INF;
                        }
                    }
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = q.poll();
                        int x = cell[0];
                        int y = cell[1];
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                            int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n &&
                                grid[nx][ny] >= '0' && grid[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                                dist[nx][ny] > dist[x][y] + 1) {
                                dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                            if (target[x][y] >= '1' && target[x][y] <= '9' &&
                                dist[x][y] <= t && dist[x][y] <= distFromStart[x][y]) {
                                addEdge(id[i][j], id[x][y] + tot, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
